Website ibighit.com/txt Tomorrow X Together ( Korean : 투모로우바이투게더 ; Tomorrow by Together ), commonly abbreviated as TXT , is a South Korean boy band formed by Big Hit Entertainment . The group consists of five members: Yeonjun , Soobin , Beomgyu , Taehyun , and Hueningkai. They debuted on March 4, 2019, with the extended play (EP) The Dream Chapter: Star . The EP debuted and peaked at number one on the Gaon Album Chart and Billboard World Albums Chart and entered the US Billboard 200 at number 140, the highest-charting debut album by any male K-pop group at the time. Its lead single " Crown " debuted at number one on the Billboard World Digital Songs chart. The group also topped the Billboard Emerging Artists chart. Tomorrow X Together was the first Korean boy band to perform and headline at Lollapalooza , one of the biggest music festivals in the US, and also the first to perform there twice. Name [ edit ] In Korean, the group's name is 투모로우바이투게더 , [ 2 ] which is "Tomorrow by Together" transliterated into Hangul ; they do not have a separate Korean version of their name. [ 3 ] According to their website, their name refers to five individuals who "come together under one dream in hopes of building a better tomorrow". [ 4 ] The full name is often shortened to 투바투 ; Tubatu by Korean media and fans. [ 5 ] [ 6 ] International media and fans often shorten the group's name to TXT. [ 8 ] History [ edit ] Pre-debut activities [ edit ] Plans for a second boy group from Big Hit Entertainment were announced by founder Bang Si-hyuk as early as 2017, [ 9 ] and a debut date for early 2019 was set in November 2018. [ 10 ] Tomorrow X Together was officially revealed on January 10, 2019. [ 11 ] [ 12 ] Over the next ten days, videos depicting each member, dubbed "introduction films," were released on YouTube .
